name: Create Password Durable User
summary: Creates exactly one durable user after all password registration proof and profile requirements are satisfied.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == password and email-ownership == verified and profile-completeness == complete and credential-proof == password-proved and durable-identity == creation-required and account-status == absent and home-workspace == not-applicable

setup: Ensure no canonical durable identity already matches the registration identity.

postconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and account-status == active and home-workspace == required and session-capability == identity-ceremony
